description: Java source code for the REST API resource class 'SpmApiResource' in the Fineract project, managing survey-related endpoints including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and activating/deactivating surveys.

classes.name: SpmApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing surveys in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: fetchAllSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all surveys, optionally filtered by active status.

methods.name: findSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves a specific survey by its ID.

methods.name: createSurvey
methods.description: Creates a new survey with provided data.

methods.name: editSurvey
methods.description: Updates an existing survey identified by ID.

methods.name: activateOrDeactivateSurvey
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a survey based on command parameter.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Generates a JSON response containing the resource ID.
